name: Merge Leads
summary: Combines duplicate lead records into one. The lead you name first is the WINNER; the others are absorbed (activities, memberships, CRM info, field values).
whenToUse: When you have duplicate people and want to collapse them into one record. Be careful — this is permanent.
confirm: Merge is PERMANENT. The winner lead absorbs all losing leads (their activities, list/program memberships, CRM info, and non-empty field values), and the losing records disappear. Max 25 losing leads per call. Continue?

path.name: id
path.label: Winning lead ID
path.hint: The record to KEEP. When field values conflict, the winner's value wins (unless it's empty).

query.name: leadIds
query.label: Losing lead ID(s)
query.hint: Comma-separated IDs of the duplicates to absorb. Max 25 (since 2026-03-31 — more returns error 1080).

query.name: mergeInCRM
query.label: Also merge in the CRM
query.hint: Only for SFDC-synced instances: perform the merge in Salesforce too. Note: CRM lead/contact type rules can override your chosen winner.

response.description: Just success/failure — Marketo returns {success: true} when the merge completes.

notes: Merge takes up to ~3 minutes server-side; it may return success before everything has settled.
If both records are in Salesforce and one is a contact while the other is a lead, the contact wins regardless of your choice.
